T: Be Afraid. Be Kind of Afraid.
D: Two years after Mystery Inc. splits up, the gang is lured back together to a spooky island resort where the guests keep coming home strangely well behaved.
P: Serve the pizza bites when Shaggy and Scooby start the hot pepper contest.
S: Cheese and oat crackers baked crisp, dog-friendly and 100% vegetarian.

Pulse the flour, oats, butter, cheese and paprika in a food processor until it looks like breadcrumbs. Add the yolk and water and pulse until it comes together, then wrap and chill for 10 minutes. Roll out 5mm thick and cut into bone shapes. Bake on a lined tray at 180C until golden, then cool on the tray.
Mini pizza rounds under jalapeños and pepperoncini. Scooby eats the whole jar of peppers.

Stir the passata with the oregano and a pinch of salt. Spread over the bases and top with mozzarella and tomatoes. Bake at 220C until bubbling and crisp, then cut into wedges. Scatter with basil and serve the peppers in a jar on the side for the brave.
4 small pita breads or pizza bases@Bakery
M: All-you-can-eat huli huli chicken with pineapple rice
Pineapple soy chicken grilled huli huli with pineapple rice. Spooky Island's all-you-can-eat deal.

Whisk the pineapple juice, soy, tomato sauce, sugar, ginger and garlic, keep a third aside and marinate the chicken in the rest for 15 minutes. Cook the rice in the coconut milk topped up with water until fluffy, then fold through the pineapple. Grill the chicken over medium heat, turning and basting with the kept sauce, until sticky and cooked through. Slice and serve over the rice with spring onions.
Meatball subs in tomato sauce with cheese.

Mix the mince, crumbs, egg, parmesan, oregano and salt and roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil, then pour in the sauce and simmer until cooked through. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce and lay the mozzarella on top. Grill until the cheese melts and serve hot.
W: Toasted coconut snowballs. Daphne bounces the sun off a disco ball.

Toast the coconut in a dry pan until golden, then cool. Scoop 8 big balls of ice cream, roll in the coconut and freeze on a lined tray. Blend the mango with the honey and a squeeze of lime. Serve two snowballs each in a puddle of mango sauce.
K: Orange, pineapple and passionfruit punch, poured for the whole van.
Mix the orange and pineapple juice with the passionfruit pulp in a big jug. Add the ice and orange slices and top with lemonade just before serving.
